category_edits.rationale: Scale attention and feed-forward residual branches by 0.5 to reduce update magnitude while preserving normalization, causal masking, depth, heads, embeddings, scoring, loss, and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the modified SASRec class, so training and inference share the architecture without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Halve both residual branch outputs in every SASRec block, retaining one trained model per dataset and all existing training settings.
